George Russell must win at COTA on Sunday.

And Antonelli must finish outside the top 9.
AND Hamilton must finish outside the top 3.

All three. In the same race. At COTA.

That's what it takes to survive Austin. #F1 #USGP

stories.title: Hamilton at COTA — The Wildcard With a History at America's Track

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Lewis Hamilton is 111 points behind the championship leader.

He's also one of the best COTA drivers in F1 history.

At 41 — in a Ferrari — he's not mathematically done yet. Sunday in Austin could be special. #F1 #USGP

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Hamilton. Ferrari. COTA.

Three words that could complicate Antonelli's title party on Sunday.

He needs chaos. But Lewis Hamilton has created chaos at the Circuit of the Americas before. #F1 #USGP
